name: human_05_vacation_heat_off_forgotten_fresh
story: Freshwater tropical tank, setpoint 27. Owner disables heating from the web UI to 'test something', forgets, and leaves for a winter weekend with the house heating off (room drops to ~11 C). The firmware obeys the user's toggle: heater idle in normal operation.

events.note: Owner disables heating to test and forgets
Vacation, house heating off, cold snap: room ~11 C

expect: Probes are all valid and agreeing, so no sensorFault and NO fail-safe: enableHeat=false is respected in normal operation, heater stays off (this is user intent, not a firmware bug).

Tank cools toward room (~11-13 C) over the days: below 22.5 C the undertemp alarm (aquatermostat/alarm/undertemp + HA) MUST fire (reading trusted) and stay active; it is the only protection. Model should show fish dropping into stress (<22) then lethal (<18) in about a day and a half.
BUG if no undertemp alarm fires, or the alarm flaps/clears while the tank keeps cooling, or the heater turns on while enableHeat=false in normal control.
Report as a design observation: the toggle has no auto re-enable timeout; suggest it as a hazard since the cold-water failure is silent apart from the notification.
